name: gpt-audio-plugin
description: Generate music and listen to attached audio for grounded music analysis through GPTAudioMCP.

interface.shortDescription: Generate music or analyze attached audio.
interface.longDescription: Stay in the normal ChatGPT conversation, attach audio when useful, and use GPTAudioMCP to either generate music or send the actual audio to a multimodal listening model for grounded critique and analysis through your connected Replicate account.
defaultPrompt: Generate music from our current conversation.
Listen to the audio file I attached and critique the arrangement, instrumentation, structure, mood, and production.
Use the audio file I attached and our conversation as the creative direction.
